A. Opening

Why This Chapter Matters

Soon, you will step into a wider world.

Some of you may continue to university. Some may join a training program. Some may apply for scholarships. Some may help family businesses. Some may work in tourism, fisheries, administration, digital services, shipping, hospitality, entrepreneurship, or community programs. Some may stay on the island and build something meaningful there. Some may travel far from home and start a new journey.

Wherever you go, you need to know how to introduce yourself professionally.

A good job application letter helps you explain why you are suitable for an opportunity. A clear CV or resume helps other people see your education, skills, experiences, achievements, and potential.

In this chapter, you will learn how to present yourself honestly, confidently, and professionally in English.

Essential Questions

What kind of professional person do I want to become?
Saya ingin menjadi pribadi profesional seperti apa?
What skills from my school and island life can become my professional strengths?
Keterampilan apa dari kehidupan sekolah dan kepulauan yang bisa menjadi kekuatan profesional saya?
How can English help me access wider opportunities?
Bagaimana Bahasa Inggris dapat membantu saya mendapatkan kesempatan yang lebih luas?
How can I write a strong application letter and CV even if I have limited work experience?
Bagaimana saya dapat menulis surat lamaran dan CV yang kuat meskipun pengalaman kerja saya masih terbatas?
B. Learning Goals

Tujuan Pembelajaran

After learning this chapter, you are expected to be able to:

  1. identify the social function, structure, and language features of a job application letter;
  2. identify the social function, structure, and language features of a CV/resume;
  3. analyze job advertisements and find important keywords;
  4. use formal and professional expressions in a job application letter;
  5. use action verbs to describe skills, activities, achievements, and experiences;
  1. write clear, polite, and persuasive application letters;
  2. create a simple, modern, and ATS-friendly CV/resume;
  3. revise writing based on peer feedback and a checklist;
  4. present a short professional self-introduction;
  5. create a professional portfolio for a dream job, internship, volunteer program, scholarship, or training opportunity.
Keterkaitan CP Fase F: Materi ini melatih kemampuan menyimak-berbicara, membaca-memirsa, dan menulis-mempresentasikan teks fungsional dengan tujuan sosial, audiens, dan konteks profesional yang jelas.

D. My Initial Understanding

Mulai dari Diri Sendiri

Gambar siswa belajar: mengeksplorasi masa depan dan mulai menyiapkan dokumen profesional.

Activity 1: Think About Your Future

Answer the questions honestly.

  1. What opportunity do you want after graduation?
    Arti: Kesempatan apa yang kamu inginkan setelah lulus?
  2. Do you want to apply for a job, internship, scholarship, training program, or volunteer program?
    Arti: Apakah kamu ingin melamar pekerjaan, magang, beasiswa, pelatihan, atau program relawan?
  3. What activities have you done at school or in your community?
    Arti: Kegiatan apa yang pernah kamu lakukan di sekolah atau masyarakat?
  4. What skills do you already have?
    Arti: Keterampilan apa yang sudah kamu miliki?
  5. What do you still need to improve?
    Arti: Apa yang masih perlu kamu tingkatkan?

Activity 2: My Skill Checklist

Put a check mark on skills you already have.

G-H. Understanding and Modeling Application Letters

Understanding Job Application Letters

Definition

A job application letter is a formal letter written by an applicant to apply for a job, internship, scholarship, training program, or volunteer opportunity.

Arti: Job application letter adalah surat resmi yang ditulis oleh pelamar untuk melamar pekerjaan, magang, beasiswa, program pelatihan, atau kesempatan relawan.

Social Function

  1. state the position you are applying for;
  2. introduce yourself professionally;
  3. explain why you are interested in the position;
  4. show that your skills and experiences match the requirements;
  5. invite the employer to read your CV and consider your application.

Difference Between Application Letter and CV

Application LetterCV/Resume
Written in paragraphsWritten in sections and bullet points
Explains motivation and suitabilityLists education, skills, experience, achievements
Persuasive and personalConcise and factual
Tailored to one positionCan be adjusted for different positions
Shows why you applyShows what you have done

Generic Structure of a Job Application Letter

PartFunction
Sender’s contactShows applicant’s address/email/phone
DateShows when the letter is written
Receiver’s addressShows the organization/company address
SalutationGreets the receiver formally
Opening paragraphStates the position and source of information
Body paragraph 1Explains interest and motivation
Body paragraph 2Explains relevant skills, experience, and achievements
Closing paragraphThanks the receiver and invites follow-up
Complimentary closeEnds the letter politely
Signature/nameShows applicant’s identity

Model Letter 1: Application for Junior Administrative Assistant

Applicant: Nur Aisyah
Nur Aisyah Coastal Village, Island District Phone: 0812-3456-7890 Email: nuraisyah.student@email.com 9 June 2026 Human Resources Officer Island Youth Cooperative Coastal District Office Dear Human Resources Officer, I am writing to apply for the Junior Administrative Assistant position at Island Youth Cooperative, as advertised on your official announcement board. I am a final-year student at senior high school, and I am interested in this opportunity because I want to develop my administrative, communication, and teamwork skills in a real professional setting. During my school years, I have been actively involved in class administration and student activities. I assisted my homeroom teacher in preparing attendance lists, organizing student data, and collecting assignment records. I also helped my class team prepare meeting notes for school events. These experiences have helped me develop responsibility, attention to detail, and basic computer skills. I believe I am a suitable candidate for this position because I am disciplined, organized, and willing to learn. I can use basic document and spreadsheet applications, communicate politely with others, and work well in a team. I am also familiar with the importance of honesty and accuracy when handling information. Please find attached my CV for your consideration. I would be grateful for the opportunity to discuss my application further. Thank you for your time and consideration. Yours faithfully, Nur Aisyah

Important Expressions

  • I am writing to apply for... = Saya menulis untuk melamar...
  • as advertised on... = sebagaimana diiklankan/diumumkan di...
  • professional setting = lingkungan profesional
  • I assisted my homeroom teacher... = Saya membantu wali kelas saya...
  • attention to detail = ketelitian
  • Please find attached my CV... = Bersama ini saya lampirkan CV saya...

Structure Analysis

  • Opening: “I am writing to apply...”
  • Motivation: “I want to develop...”
  • Relevant experience: “I assisted my homeroom teacher...”
  • Strengths: “disciplined, organized, and willing to learn”
  • Closing: “Thank you for your time and consideration.”

Why This Letter Is Persuasive

The applicant does not only say, “I am responsible.” She gives evidence: helping with attendance lists, organizing data, and preparing meeting notes. This makes the letter stronger.

Model Letter 2: Application for Marine Tourism Volunteer

Applicant: Muhammad Fikri
Muhammad Fikri Harbor Area, Coastal Island Phone: 0821-5678-9012 Email: fikri.coastalyouth@email.com 12 June 2026 Volunteer Coordinator Blue Coast Community Program Small Island Tourism Area Dear Volunteer Coordinator, I am writing to apply for the Marine Tourism Volunteer position at Blue Coast Community Program. I learned about this opportunity from a community announcement shared by my school. I am interested in this program because I care about coastal cleanliness and responsible tourism in island communities. As a student who lives in a coastal area, I understand that the sea is important for transportation, tourism, food, and community life. At school, I participated in a student campaign to reduce plastic waste around the classroom and beach area. I also helped my classmates prepare simple posters about environmental awareness. Through these activities, I developed teamwork, communication skills, and a stronger sense of responsibility. I believe I can contribute to your program because I am friendly, willing to work outdoors, and able to communicate politely with visitors. I can also use basic English expressions to welcome guests and explain simple environmental messages. For example, I can say, “Please keep the beach clean,” and “Thank you for helping us protect the coast.” I have attached my CV for your consideration. I would be very grateful if I could join this volunteer program and learn more about marine tourism and environmental education. Thank you for your time and consideration. Yours faithfully, Muhammad Fikri

Important Expressions

  • I care about coastal cleanliness = Saya peduli terhadap kebersihan pesisir
  • responsible tourism = pariwisata yang bertanggung jawab
  • I understand that the sea is important... = Saya memahami bahwa laut itu penting...
  • I can contribute to your program = Saya dapat berkontribusi pada program Anda
  • environmental messages = pesan-pesan lingkungan

Action Verbs Used

  • learned = mengetahui/mempelajari
  • participated = berpartisipasi
  • helped = membantu
  • developed = mengembangkan
  • contribute = berkontribusi

Model Letter 3: Application for Social Media Assistant

Applicant: Siti Rahmah
Siti Rahmah Island Residential Area Phone: 0852-2222-3344 Email: sitirahmah.digital@email.com 15 June 2026 Owner Tidal Craft and Seaweed Products Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to apply for the Social Media Assistant internship at Tidal Craft and Seaweed Products. I found the vacancy on your social media page, and I am interested in the position because I enjoy creating digital content and promoting local products.   • I found the vacancy on... = Saya menemukan lowongan tersebut di...

  • local products = produk lokal
  • I have gained useful experience = Saya telah memperoleh pengalaman yang berguna

  • consistently = secara konsisten

Model Letter 4: Application for English Club Event Internship

Applicant: Andi Pratama
Andi Pratama Coastal Village, Island Regency Phone: 0813-8888-1010 Email: andipratama.english@email.com 17 June 2026 Program Coordinator Youth Language Center Dear Program Coordinator, I am writing to apply for the English Club Event Intern position at Youth Language Center. I am interested in this opportunity because I want to improve my English communication skills while helping other students practice speaking in a supportive environment. I have been an active member of my school English Club for one year. During that time, I participated in weekly speaking practice, helped prepare simple discussion topics, and supported my friends during group presentations. I also assisted the club leader in organizing a small English Day activity at school. These experiences taught me the importance of preparation, teamwork, confidence, and clear communication. I believe I am a suitable candidate for this internship because I am responsible, punctual, and motivated to learn. I can communicate in basic English, use online meeting tools, and create simple posters for announcements. I also enjoy working with other students and helping them feel more confident when speaking English. I have attached my CV and a copy of my English Club certificate for your consideration. I would be grateful for the opportunity to discuss my application further. Thank you for your time and consideration. Yours sincerely, Andi Pratama
Why This Letter Works: The letter is strong because it connects the applicant’s real school experience with the requirements of the internship. It also uses formal phrases and action verbs such as participated, helped, supported, assisted, organized, taught, communicate, create.
I-J. Language Focus

Formal Business Register and Action Verbs

Formal Business Register

A job application letter must use formal and professional language. Avoid expressions that sound too casual.

Informal ExpressionFormal/Professional VersionArti Bahasa Indonesia
I want this job.I am writing to apply for this position.Saya menulis untuk melamar posisi ini.
I saw your job post.I learned about this vacancy from your announcement.Saya mengetahui lowongan ini dari pengumuman Anda.
I’m good at talking to people.I have strong communication skills.Saya memiliki keterampilan komunikasi yang kuat.
I helped my teacher.I assisted my teacher in preparing class documents.Saya membantu guru saya menyiapkan dokumen kelas.
I can use computer.I can use basic computer applications.Saya dapat menggunakan aplikasi komputer dasar.
I really need this job.I am highly interested in this opportunity.Saya sangat tertarik pada kesempatan ini.
Please choose me.I hope my application can be considered.Saya berharap lamaran saya dapat dipertimbangkan.
Thanks a lot.Thank you for your time and consideration.Terima kasih atas waktu dan pertimbangan Bapak/Ibu.
I’m waiting for your reply.I look forward to hearing from you.Saya menantikan kabar dari Bapak/Ibu.
I’m a hardworking person.I am a disciplined and responsible candidate.Saya adalah kandidat yang disiplin dan bertanggung jawab.

Practice 1: Rewrite the Sentences

Rewrite the informal sentences into formal sentences.

  1. I want to join your program.
  2. I am good at making posts.
  3. I helped in school events.
  4. I can talk to people.
  5. Please read my CV.
  1. I am writing to apply for your program.
  2. I have basic skills in creating social media content.
  3. I assisted in organizing school events.
  4. I have good communication skills.
  5. Please find attached my CV for your consideration.

Action Verbs for Professional Achievements

Weak writing often sounds unclear. Strong action verbs help the reader understand what you actually did.

Weak Sentence
I was in the English Club.
Arti: Saya berada/ikut di English Club.
Stronger Sentence
I participated actively in the English Club and helped organize weekly speaking practice.
Arti: Saya aktif berpartisipasi dalam English Club dan membantu mengatur latihan speaking mingguan.

CV Bullet Point Formula

Action Verb + Task/Responsibility + Context/Result
  1. Assisted my teacher in preparing attendance records for class activities.
    Membantu guru saya menyiapkan daftar hadir untuk kegiatan kelas.
  2. Organized a small group discussion about reducing plastic waste at school.
    Mengatur diskusi kelompok kecil tentang pengurangan sampah plastik di sekolah.
  3. Managed class social media announcements for student activities.
    Mengelola pengumuman media sosial kelas untuk kegiatan siswa.
  4. Created simple English captions for local product promotion.
    Membuat caption Bahasa Inggris sederhana untuk promosi produk lokal.
  5. Presented a group project about marine environmental issues.
    Mempresentasikan proyek kelompok tentang isu lingkungan laut.

Practice 2: Improve Weak Sentences

Weak SentenceStronger Version
I joined OSIS.I participated in OSIS activities and helped coordinate student programs.
I helped my parents.I assisted my family in preparing and selling local products.
I like English.I developed my English communication skills through classroom practice and English Club activities.
I can use Instagram.I managed simple social media posts for class announcements.
I was a group leader.I coordinated a student group project and helped my team complete the task on time.
K. Grammar and Sentence Pattern Lab

Grammar Lab for Application Letter and CV

1. Simple Past Tense for Past Experience

Use Simple Past Tense to describe experiences that happened in the past.

Pattern: Subject + Verb 2 + Object/Complement

  • I assisted my teacher during a school event. = Saya membantu guru saya saat acara sekolah.
  • I joined English Club last year. = Saya mengikuti English Club tahun lalu.
  • I created a poster for a class project. = Saya membuat poster untuk proyek kelas.
  • I helped organize a beach clean-up activity. = Saya membantu mengatur kegiatan bersih pantai.
Common Mistake:
Wrong: I assist my teacher yesterday.
Correct: I assisted my teacher yesterday.
Penjelasan: Karena ada kata yesterday, gunakan Verb 2.

2. Present Simple for Current Skills

Use Present Simple to describe current skills, facts, and habits.

  • I have good communication skills. = Saya memiliki keterampilan komunikasi yang baik.
  • I understand basic computer applications. = Saya memahami aplikasi komputer dasar.
  • I speak Indonesian and basic English. = Saya berbicara Bahasa Indonesia dan Bahasa Inggris dasar.
  • I work well in a team. = Saya bekerja dengan baik dalam tim.

3. Present Perfect for Life Experience

Use Present Perfect to describe experiences that are relevant until now.

Pattern: Subject + have/has + Verb 3

  • I have developed teamwork skills through school activities. = Saya telah mengembangkan keterampilan kerja sama melalui kegiatan sekolah.
  • I have participated in several class projects. = Saya telah berpartisipasi dalam beberapa proyek kelas.
  • I have learned basic digital skills from online learning. = Saya telah mempelajari keterampilan digital dasar dari pembelajaran online.
  • I have improved my confidence through speaking practice. = Saya telah meningkatkan kepercayaan diri melalui latihan speaking.

4. Modal Verbs for Polite Tone

Modal ExpressionArtiExample
I would like to...Saya ingin...I would like to apply for this internship.
I would be grateful if...Saya akan sangat berterima kasih jika...I would be grateful if you considered my application.
May I...Bolehkah saya...May I provide further information if needed?
Could you...Bisakah Bapak/Ibu...Could you please inform me about the next step?

5. Prepositions in Professional English

ExpressionArtiExample
apply formelamar untukI want to apply for the internship.
interested intertarik padaI am interested in this position.
responsible forbertanggung jawab atasI was responsible for preparing attendance records.
familiar withfamiliar/terbiasa denganI am familiar with social media platforms.
suitable forsesuai untukI believe I am suitable for this role.
contribute toberkontribusi padaI can contribute to your program.
participate inberpartisipasi dalamI participated in school activities.
assist withmembantu dalamI assisted with event preparation.
L-M. Understanding CV / Resume

Building a Modern Professional CV

What Is a CV?

A CV or Curriculum Vitae is a document that shows your education, skills, experiences, achievements, projects, and qualifications.

Arti: CV adalah dokumen yang menunjukkan pendidikan, keterampilan, pengalaman, prestasi, proyek, dan kualifikasi seseorang.

What Is a Resume?

A resume is usually shorter and more targeted to a specific job or opportunity.

Arti: Resume biasanya lebih ringkas dan disesuaikan dengan pekerjaan atau kesempatan tertentu.

For Students

For students, a CV and resume can be simple, clear, and focused on relevant school, organization, volunteer, and skill experiences.

ATS-Friendly CV

ATS means Applicant Tracking System. It is a system that some companies use to scan applications.

A simple ATS-friendly CV should:

  1. use clear headings;
  2. avoid too many decorations;
  3. use relevant keywords from the job advertisement;
  4. use bullet points;
  5. use simple fonts;
  6. avoid fake experience;
  7. include correct contact information;
  8. be easy to read.

Good CV Headings

Contact InformationProfessional SummaryEducationSkillsExperienceOrganization ExperienceVolunteer ExperienceProjectsAchievementsCertificationsLanguages

What Students Can Include in a CV

Experience TypeExample
School activitiesClass leader, committee member, English Club member
OrganizationOSIS, scout, youth community
Volunteer workBeach clean-up, school event volunteer
Family businessHelping sell products, managing simple records
Digital projectsPosters, captions, videos, social media posts
Academic achievementsClass rank, competition, certificates
SkillsEnglish, computer, communication, teamwork
Local knowledgeTourism, fisheries, seaweed, local product promotion

Vocabulary Preview

prepare = menyiapkanopportunity = kesempatanhonest = jujurrelevant = relevan/sesuaiclear layout = tata letak yang jelasexperience = pengalamanachievement = pencapaian/prestasi
Audio Practice 1Dengarkan dulu tanpa membaca. Setelah itu buka script untuk cek pemahaman.
Script terbuka. Klik salah satu kalimat untuk mendengarkan kalimat itu saja.
Good morning, students. Today, we will talk about preparing a CV. A CV is not only a list of information. It is a professional document that introduces who you are, what you can do, and what experiences you have. As final-year students, you may think that you do not have enough experience. However, experience can come from many places. If you joined a school organization, helped your teacher, supported a family business, participated in a community activity, or created a digital project, you already have something valuable to write. A good CV must be clear, honest, and relevant. Do not write fake experience. Do not include unnecessary personal information. Use simple headings such as Education, Skills, Experience, Projects, and Achievements. Use action verbs like assisted, organized, managed, created, and participated. Remember, your CV should help the reader understand your potential quickly. Keep it neat, focused, and professional.

Comprehension Questions

  1. What is the main topic of the talk?
  2. Why should students not worry too much about limited experience?
  3. Mention three examples of student experiences.
  4. What are three qualities of a good CV?
  5. Why should students use action verbs?

  3. A good CV must be clear, honest, and .
  4. Do not write experience.
  5. Use action verbs such as assisted, organized, and .

Fikri: Then we should prepare our CV first and choose the most relevant experiences. Rina: Yes. We should not include everything, only experiences that match the volunteer program.

Speaking Activity 1: My Professional Identity

Use the sentence starters.

  1. My name is __________.
  2. I am interested in __________.
  3. My strongest skill is __________.
  4. I developed this skill by __________.

Model Answer
My name is Siti Rahmah. I am interested in digital communication and local product promotion. My strongest skill is creativity. I developed this skill by creating captions and editing photos for class projects. In the future, I want to work in social media marketing or start a small digital business.

Arti: Nama saya Siti Rahmah. Saya tertarik pada komunikasi digital dan promosi produk lokal. Keterampilan terkuat saya adalah kreativitas. Saya mengembangkan keterampilan ini dengan membuat caption dan mengedit foto untuk proyek kelas. Di masa depan, saya ingin bekerja di bidang pemasaran media sosial atau memulai usaha digital kecil.

Model Conversation 1: Asking About a Job Advertisement

Rani: Excuse me, I would like to ask about the internship advertisement.
Officer: Sure. What would you like to know?
Rani: What documents should I submit?
Officer: You need to submit an application letter, a CV, and relevant certificates.
Rani: Thank you. Is basic English communication required?
Officer: Yes, it is preferred, especially for communicating with visitors.
Rani: I see. Thank you for the information.
Officer: You’re welcome.

Useful Phrases

  • I would like to ask about... = Saya ingin bertanya tentang...
  • What documents should I submit? = Dokumen apa yang harus saya kirimkan?
  • Is basic English communication required? = Apakah komunikasi Bahasa Inggris dasar diperlukan?
  • Thank you for the information. = Terima kasih atas informasinya.

Model Conversation 2: Mini Interview

Interviewer: Please tell me about yourself.
Applicant: My name is Fikri. I am a final-year student. I am interested in marine tourism and environmental programs.
Interviewer: What experience do you have?
Applicant: I participated in a school campaign to reduce plastic waste. I also helped prepare posters about coastal cleanliness.
Interviewer: What skills did you develop from those activities?
Applicant: I developed teamwork, communication, and responsibility.
Interviewer: Why should we choose you?
Applicant: I am willing to learn, friendly, and familiar with coastal community life.

Model Conversation 3: Discussing a CV

Aisyah: Can you check my CV?
Rina: Sure. Your CV is clear, but your experience section needs stronger verbs.
Aisyah: What do you mean?
Rina: Instead of writing “I was in a committee,” you can write “Assisted the committee in preparing student registration.”
Aisyah: That sounds more professional.
Rina: Yes. Also, make sure your email address looks professional.
Aisyah: Thank you. I will revise it.

Presenter: My application letter explains my motivation and relevant experience. In my CV, I included my education, skills, class administration experience, and school activities.
Presenter: I believe I am suitable for this position because I am organized, responsible, and willing to learn.
Presenter: Thank you for listening to my presentation.

R. Reading Practice

Reading Application Letter

Read the application letter below.

Dewi Lestari Island Community Area Phone: 0812-5555-9090 Email: dewilestari.work@email.com 20 June 2026 Hiring Manager Coastal Learning Center Dear Hiring Manager, I am writing to apply for the Student Learning Assistant internship at Coastal Learning Center. I learned about this opportunity from my English teacher. I am interested in this internship because I enjoy helping other students learn and I want to improve my communication and teaching support skills. I am a final-year senior high school student with experience in group learning activities. I have assisted my classmates during English practice, helped prepare discussion questions, and supported younger students during school orientation. These activities helped me develop patience, teamwork, and confidence in speaking. I believe I am suitable for this internship because I am responsible, friendly, and willing to learn. I can communicate clearly, work with a team, and use basic digital tools for learning activities. I hope this internship will help me grow while allowing me to contribute to your learning program. Please find attached my CV for your consideration. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you. Yours faithfully, Dewi Lestari

Comprehension Questions

  1. What position is Dewi applying for?
  2. How did Dewi learn about the opportunity?
  3. Why is she interested in the internship?
  4. What experiences does she mention?
  5. What skills did she develop?
  6. What strengths does she mention in the third paragraph?
  7. What document does she attach?
  8. Is the tone formal or informal? Give evidence.
  9. Which sentence shows her motivation?
  10. Which sentence shows her suitability?
  1. Student Learning Assistant internship.
  2. From her English teacher.
  3. Because she enjoys helping other students learn and wants to improve communication and teaching support skills.
  4. Assisting classmates, preparing discussion questions, supporting younger students.
  5. Patience, teamwork, and confidence in speaking.
  6. Responsible, friendly, and willing to learn.
  7. Her CV.
  8. Formal. Evidence: “I am writing to apply...”, “Thank you for your time and consideration.”
  9. “I am interested in this internship because...”
  10. “I believe I am suitable for this internship because...”

V. Final Project

My Professional Portfolio

Gambar siswa belajar: presentasi professional portfolio di depan kelas.

Project Brief

Create a professional portfolio for one real or realistic opportunity. You may choose:

  • a job;
  • an internship;
  • a volunteer program;
  • a scholarship;
  • a training program;
  • a digital project;
  • a community program.

Required Components

  1. Target Opportunity
    Include the job/program advertisement or your own realistic opportunity description.
  2. Application Letter
    Write one formal application letter tailored to the opportunity.
  3. CV/Resume
    Create a one-page CV/resume with clear headings and relevant information.
  1. Professional Self-Introduction
    Write a short 45–60 second self-introduction.
  2. Reflection Paragraph
    Write one paragraph about what you learned from creating your portfolio.

Final Project Checklist

Self-Introduction Template

Good morning. My name is __________. I am a final-year senior high school student. I am interested in __________. I have developed skills in __________ through __________. I believe I am suitable for this opportunity because __________. I am willing to learn, work with others, and contribute positively. Thank you.

Reflection Guide

  1. What did you learn about yourself?
  2. What skills can you offer?
  3. What experience did you include in your CV?
  4. What part was difficult?
  5. What will you improve before applying for a real opportunity?
W. Enrichment and Remedial

Remedial and Enrichment

Remedial Activities

For students who need more support:

  1. Rearrange a scrambled application letter.
  2. Complete a fill-in-the-blank application letter.
  3. Match formal phrases with their meanings.
  4. Rewrite informal sentences into formal sentences.
  5. Complete a simple CV template.

Enrichment Activities

For students who want more challenge:

  1. Rewrite a CV for two different opportunities.
  2. Compare two applicants and decide who is more suitable.
  3. Create a LinkedIn-style professional summary.
  4. Record a one-minute professional introduction video.
  5. Design a simple digital portfolio outline.
X. Answer Key Summary

Answer Key Summary

Practice 1 Possible Answers

  1. I am writing to apply for your program.
  2. I have basic skills in creating social media content.
  3. I assisted in organizing school events.
  4. I have good communication skills.
  5. Please find attached my CV for your consideration.

Reading Practice Possible Answers

  1. Student Learning Assistant internship.
  2. From her English teacher.
  3. Because she enjoys helping other students learn and wants to improve communication and teaching support skills.
  4. Assisting classmates, preparing discussion questions, supporting younger students.
  5. Patience, teamwork, and confidence in speaking.
  6. Responsible, friendly, and willing to learn.
  7. Her CV.
  8. Formal. Evidence: “I am writing to apply...”, “Thank you for your time and consideration.”
  9. “I am interested in this internship because...”
  10. “I believe I am suitable for this internship because...”

Y. Source References

Sumber Rujukan

Materi ini dikembangkan dengan menyesuaikan prinsip Capaian Pembelajaran Bahasa Inggris Fase F Kurikulum Merdeka, penyusunan Tujuan Pembelajaran dan Alur Tujuan Pembelajaran, pendekatan genre-based learning, project-based learning, task-based language teaching, dan pembelajaran mendalam/deep learning.

  1. Capaian Pembelajaran Bahasa Inggris Fase F — Kemdikdasmen / Ruang GTK.
  2. Panduan perumusan Tujuan Pembelajaran dan Alur Tujuan Pembelajaran — Rumah Pendidikan Kemdikdasmen.
  3. Panduan Pembelajaran dan Asesmen Kurikulum Merdeka.
  4. Prinsip pembelajaran mendalam/deep learning dalam pengembangan pembelajaran bermakna.
  5. Referensi umum business writing, job application letter, curriculum vitae/resume writing, and professional communication.
  6. Cambridge Dictionary and Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries for vocabulary checking.
  7. Purdue Online Writing Lab resources for professional writing and resume guidance.
